app_info.subtitle: Inspect Prefect workflows
app_info.description: Prefect helps users inspect Prefect Cloud and self-hosted workflows, diagnose failed, late, or stuck runs, review workspace health and rate limits, and look up current Prefect documentation and release notes.

justifications.read_only_justification: Returns guidance about the available Prefect tools without accessing or changing workspace data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not write to public internet state or any external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke, or otherwise modify data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves the connected Prefect instance and user identity without modifying either.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only reads private Prefect connection information and does not publish externally.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke, or otherwise modify Prefect resources.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves flow-run, work-pool, and concurrency-limit summaries without changing workspace state.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only reads private Prefect workspace data and does not publish externally.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke, or otherwise modify Prefect resources.

justifications.read_only_justification: Lists or retrieves Prefect deployments and their recent runs without changing them.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only reads private Prefect workspace data and does not publish externally.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not create, update, pause, or delete deployments.

justifications.read_only_justification: Lists or retrieves registered Prefect flows without changing them.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only reads private Prefect workspace data and does not publish externally.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not create, update, or delete flows.

justifications.read_only_justification: Lists or retrieves Prefect flow-run state and metadata without changing any run.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only reads private Prefect workspace data and does not publish externally.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not start, cancel, retry, or delete flow runs.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves existing execution logs for a selected flow run without writing new logs.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only reads private Prefect workspace logs and does not transmit them to another system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not alter or delete logs or flow runs.

justifications.read_only_justification: Lists or retrieves Prefect task-run state and metadata without changing any run.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only reads private Prefect workspace data and does not publish externally.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not start, cancel, retry, or delete task runs.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves work-pool, queue, and worker-health information without changing configuration.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only reads private Prefect workspace data and does not publish externally.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not create, pause, update, or delete work pools or queues.

justifications.read_only_justification: Reads existing Prefect event records for a requested time range without emitting events.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only reads private Prefect workspace events and does not publish externally.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not alter or delete event records.

justifications.read_only_justification: Lists or retrieves Prefect automation configuration without changing it.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only reads private Prefect workspace data and does not execute automation actions.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not create, enable, disable, update, or delete automations.

justifications.read_only_justification: Computes and returns a Prefect object schema without accessing or changing workspace state.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not write to public internet state or any external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke, or otherwise modify data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves Prefect Cloud rate-limit usage and throttling periods without changing account limits.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only reads private Prefect Cloud account telemetry and does not publish externally.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not modify limits, usage records, or account configuration.

justifications.read_only_justification: Lists Prefect Cloud workspaces already selected during OAuth consent without changing authorization.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only reads private OAuth grant scope and does not publish externally.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not grant, revoke, or modify workspace access.

justifications.read_only_justification: Searches the Prefect documentation index and returns matching excerpts without changing documentation.
justifications.open_world_justification: Retrieves public Prefect documentation and does not publish or modify internet content.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke, or otherwise modify data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves authoritative Prefect OSS release notes without changing release or documentation data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Retrieves public release information and does not publish or modify internet content.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke, or otherwise modify data.

test_cases.description: Diagnose a recent failed flow run from its state and execution logs.
test_cases.user_prompt: Why did my latest Prefect flow run fail?
test_cases.expected_output: Identifies the latest failed run, summarizes the concrete failure from its logs, and suggests a relevant next diagnostic step.

test_cases.description: Diagnose late or stuck runs using workspace and worker health.
test_cases.user_prompt: Which Prefect runs are late or stuck, and what is blocking them?
test_cases.expected_output: Summarizes affected runs and correlates them with work-pool, queue, deployment, or concurrency-limit health.

test_cases.description: Retrieve the latest authoritative Prefect OSS release notes.
test_cases.user_prompt: What changed in the latest Prefect release?
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the latest stable Prefect OSS version, release date and URL when available, and a concise summary of enhancements and fixes.

test_cases.description: Answer a Prefect usage question from current documentation.
test_cases.user_prompt: How should I configure retries for a Prefect flow?
test_cases.expected_output: Explains the relevant current Prefect guidance using matching documentation excerpts and source links when available.

test_cases.description: Review Prefect Cloud throttling for a recent incident.
test_cases.user_prompt: Were Prefect Cloud rate limits responsible for our 429 errors during the last three days?
test_cases.expected_output: Reports whether throttling occurred, the affected operation groups and periods, and the observed denial counts without changing account settings.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invoke read-only MCP tools to trigger a deployment.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Trigger my production Prefect deployment now.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not invoke an MCP tool because the server is read-only; it should explain that the Prefect CLI is required for this mutation.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invoke read-only MCP tools to cancel or delete a run.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Cancel and delete this Prefect flow run.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not invoke an MCP tool because cancellation and deletion are mutations; it should direct the user to the Prefect CLI.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invoke Prefect for an unrelated consumer request.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: What will the weather be tomorrow?
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because weather information is outside its supported Prefect workflows.
